patchnotes.label: Patch Notes
patchnotes.description: Watch game and software patch notes, then publish them in selected channels.

embed.noDescription: No summary available. Open the link to read the full note.

g0.label: Subscriptions
g0.description: One row per game or software followed: the bot publishes every new patch note in the chosen channel.

subscriptions.label: Sources followed

roleId.label: Role to mention
roleId.help: Optional: mentioned on every new note.

subscriptions.help: One row per followed game: the source, the announcement channel, and a role to ping. Sources come from a built-in catalogue — a source dropped from it makes the subscription disappear from this list, without warning. Only notes published AFTER the row is added get announced: adding a game does not replay its history.

publishLatest.label: Publish the latest note
publishLatest.help: Immediately sends the latest patch note of the chosen source to its channel.

sourceId.label: Source
sourceId.help: Must match a subscription already saved above.

raisons.channelUnavailable: channel not found or not a text channel
raisons.noNotes: no note found on the source

msg.noSubscription: This source has no saved subscription yet.
